mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_feedback_content() VALUES(#{row.sourceId},#{row.title}, #{row.description},#{row.functionModule},#{row.problemType},CAST(#{row.feedbackTags} AS JSON),#{row.usageStage}, #{row.severityLevel},#{row.issueCategory},#{row.userSentiment},#{row.reproducibility},#{row.mappingError}, #{row.mappingRuleVersion},#{row.normalizationVersion},#{row.processingStatus},#{row.maskingStatus}, #{row.dataQualityScore},#{row.qualityRuleVersion},#{row.isDeleted},#{row.createdBy},#{row.updatedBy}, #{row.createdAt},#{row.updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title=VALUES(title),description=VALUES(description), function_module=VALUES(function_module),problem_type=VALUES(problem_type),feedback_tags=VALUES(feedback_tags), usage_stage=VALUES(usage_stage),severity_level=VALUES(severity_level),issue_category=VALUES(issue_category), user_sentiment=VALUES(user_sentiment),reproducibility=VALUES(reproducibility),mapping_error=VALUES(mapping_error), mapping_rule_version=VALUES(mapping_rule_version),normalization_version=VALUES(normalization_version), processing_status=VALUES(processing_status),masking_status=VALUES(masking_status),data_quality_score=VALUES(data_quality_score), quality_rule_version=VALUES(quality_rule_version),is_deleted=VALUES(is_deleted),updated_by=VALUES(updated_by), updated_at=VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_feedback_content WHERE masking_status=#{status} ORDER BY source_id
SELECT FROM t_feedback_content WHERE processing_status=#{status} ORDER BY source_id
